answer: Reaching eligibility takes 31 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The glacier register is checked at draw time, orchard lists the eligible set, and pigment seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 31 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 31 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
